title: Karter maintenance template (v2)
description: Schema for Karter maintenance templates. Validates the raw file structure; merge-time invariants (interval_km/label/description present after inheritance) and checks not expressible in draft-07 (unique ids/codes within an array, meta.years ordering) are enforced by templates/tools/build_catalog.py.

extends.description: Relative paths (from templates/data/) of the templates it extends, in order of application. Entities in later files override earlier ones by id.

parts.description: Part catalog. Entries merge by id with the parents. Whether an entry is new or an override is determined during resolution, so required fields for new parts (name or i18n_key) are validated after merge at application level. Ids must be unique within this array; also validated by build_catalog.py.

maintenance_items.description: Maintenance tasks. Entries merge by id with the parents. New items must define interval_km (validated after merge at application level). Ids must be unique within this array; also validated by build_catalog.py. May be empty in per-model base.json placeholder fragments.

obd_dtc_definitions.description: Fault codes for this model or powertrain. Entries merge by code with the parents; entries that only override inherited fields may omit description/desc_i18n_key. Codes must be unique within this array; also validated by build_catalog.py.

years.description: Start year (required) / end year (null if still in production). Ordering (start <= end) is validated by build_catalog.py.

market.description: Target markets: EU, US, JP, etc.

engine.description: Engine specifics used for template matching

part.description: A part in the catalog. id is always required; name or i18n_key is required for parts that are new (not inherited) - validated after merge.

id.description: Part ID. If it already exists in the parent, it replaces it. Otherwise, it is added.

name.description: Part name. Only needed if it is a new part (not inherited); validated after merge.

i18n_key.description: Translation key for the name, e.g.: part_oil_filter

user_reference.description: User's preferred reference (local layer), overrides oem_number

description.description: Long description of the part shown in the parts section

remove.description: true -> removes this part from the parent

partRef.description: A part referenced by a maintenance item

part_id.description: Part id as declared in the parts catalog

quantity.description: Quantity of this part used by the task (defaults to 1 when omitted)

maintenanceItem.description: A maintenance task. id is always required; interval_km and a label are required for items that are new (not inherited) - validated after merge.

id.description: Item ID. If it already exists in the parent, it replaces it. Otherwise, it is added.

label.description: Only needed if it is a new item (not inherited). If it is a replace, the parent's label is used.

i18n_key.description: Translation key for the label, e.g.: seed_interval_oil_change

desc_i18n_key.description: Translation key for the description, e.g.: seed_desc_oil_change

description.description: Long description shown in the maintenance section
examples: Replace engine oil and filter. Use OEM-spec 5W-30.

parts.description: Parts needed for this task, referenced by part_id

obd_codes.description: OBD-II (DTC) codes related to this task

remove.description: true -> removes this item from the parent (useful when a model does not have a generic task)

dtc.description: An OBD-II fault code definition. code and scope are always required; description is required for codes that are new (not inherited) - validated after merge.

scope.description: standard -> generic SAE code (P0xxx); manufacturer -> manufacturer-specific code (P1xxx, P0Axx, etc.)

description.description: Only needed if it is a new code (not inherited); validated after merge.

desc_i18n_key.description: Translation key for the description, e.g.: dtc_p0171

related_maintenance.description: Suggested maintenance_item IDs to resolve the code

related_parts.description: Suggested part IDs to resolve the code

remove.description: true -> removes this code from the parent

i18nKey.description: Translation key, must exist in templates/i18n/{locale}.json

dtcCode.description: OBD-II code (5 chars: letter + 4 hex digits)

quantity.description: Amount of a part. Must be greater than 0 (fractions allowed).

remove.description: true -> removes the inherited entity from this template's result
